narrative: BYD's first public confirmation of an in-house humanoid program - running since 2022 under its electronic-integration unit, with factory-floor prototypes and planned distribution through its existing auto-dealer network - establishes precisely the supply-chain-leveraged, automaker-integrated entrant the forecast is built on, joining Tesla as a second high-volume automaker pursuing motors, batteries, and chips as a shared robotics foundation.
remaining_gap: Whether a third high-volume automaker beyond BYD and Tesla formally confirms a comparable program before Q2 2027.
